QUOTE: "Document it, exactly once. Give it either a `/** ... */` comment before the define or a `/*!< ... */` comment after it." and "Regenerate, don't hand-edit. Run the normal build ... which calls `generate_errors.pl`. Do not edit `library/error.c` directly."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says to add a documented #define to the module header in include/mbedtls/, regenerate with the script, and not edit library/error.c directly.
